name: Firewall Dragon @Ignister
text:
'The Arrival Cyberse @Ignister' + 'Firewall Dragon Darkfluid'
While you have a 'Firewall' Link or Xyz monster, and an '@Ignister' Link, Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz monster in your GY this card cannot be targeted by card effect. Once Per Turn: You can banish a Link monster from your GY, Target a monster that has a lower ATK then the banished monster, banish that card. If you have 'The Arrival Cyberse @Ignister' and 'Firewall Dragon Darkfluid' in your GY this card gains 5000 ATK
